# unbounded API access
gh api repos/owner/repo
gh api graphql -f query=x

# mutating verbs
gh pr create --title x --body y
gh pr close 42
gh pr merge 42
gh pr comment 42 --body hi
gh pr checkout 42
gh issue create --title x
gh issue close 7
gh repo clone owner/repo
gh repo delete owner/repo

# config / credential / extensibility commands
gh auth login
gh auth status
gh config set editor vim
gh alias set co "pr checkout"
gh extension install owner/gh-ext
gh ssh-key add key.pub
gh secret set FOO
gh gpg-key add key.gpg
gh codespace create

# unrecognized noun/verb combos
gh workflow list
gh run list
gh release list

# noun with no verb
gh pr
gh issue
gh repo

# bare gh with no subcommand at all
gh

# mutating gh commands stay unsafe even when their output is redirected
gh pr merge 42 > out.txt
gh pr view 42 > out.txt && gh pr merge 42

# command substitution / subshells are treated as unsafe
gh pr view $(echo 1)
gh pr view `echo 1`

# compound commands where at least one part is unsafe
gh pr list && gh pr merge 42
gh pr view 1 | gh pr comment 1 --body -
